shots.seen: Uncle in pale kurta and grey shawl centre-left of a blue-lit bay, shadowed eyes, barred window right, chain left; the blue lamp pool sits behind his head; lower third is dark berth.
problems: Lower third still empty and the torso is a plain triangle.
shots.fix: Add shawl folds and brighter seat stitching; keep clarity pass.

shots.seen: Aisle receding to a green exit lamp with tube lights, side berths as coloured blocks, new foreground curtain with two bare feet at left.
problems: Berth blocks are crude and the right half is boxy; contrast is low.
shots.fix: Raise tube contrast, add post contrast and darker ink on the berth blocks.

shots.seen: Yellowed ticket with S7 and 14-06-2014 clear, held by a brown stick-like forearm with a thumb; the hand reads but is crude.
problems: Hand is cartoonish; background has many tints.
shots.fix: Taper the forearm, show the cloth cuff, desaturate the backdrop.

shots.seen: Uncle head and shoulders filling frame, eyes in shadow under the brow, blue lamp bloom behind and barred window; clothes are dark.
problems: Torso nearly black, large dark cells.
shots.fix: Lift the shawl and kurta with window rim and more bg detail.

shots.seen: Uncle seated in a dim bay with a flickering ceiling tube above and fog-grey window behind; he is large now but low-contrast against the wall.
problems: Subject does not separate from the wall.
shots.fix: Brighten his key and rim, raise window fog so he silhouettes against it.

shots.seen: Uncle lying on his side facing the lens, head large on a pillow, eyes with small glints, maroon blanket and berth behind.
problems: Glints were oversized crosshairs; face is flat.
shots.fix: Shrink glints to the eye catchlights, add lamp rim on the face.

shots.seen: Berth stacks with a sleeper and one hanging sleeve and hand holding a yellow ticket per bay; steel post in front.
problems: Sleeve reads as a pipe; scene is dark with low contrast.
shots.fix: Fold lines on the sleeve, brighter tickets, higher contrast grade.

shots.seen: Window full of warm platform with a yellow ITARSI board, uncle in pale kurta rising, bars across his face; warm wash over the berth.
problems: Palette too wide, mean luma high.
shots.fix: Cut saturation and warm intensity, keep the board legible.

shots.seen: Dim bay, empty seat with the uncle's grey shawl, lids closing from top and bottom; last frame black with a blue lamp glow.
problems: Shawl still faint in the first frame.
shots.fix: Brighter seat light on the shawl and slower lid closure.

shots.seen: Platform through a big window with the Bhopal board blurred sideways, cool lamps; flash on the first frame.
problems: Board is a smear; palette wide.
shots.fix: Bigger board at the hit and less colour variety.

shots.seen: Same framing as s3 with a blue-cuffed narrator hand; ticket paler and yellowing across the line.
Narrator on the uncle's berth in the s1 framing in blue shirt and shawl; matches s1.
